takeaways: Power Apps fail where ambiguity is allowed: duplicated formulas, hidden globals, personal connections and unmanaged delegation create silent drift.
The With() function, pure user-defined functions and contract-based components with enhanced component properties keep logic local, named and reusable.
Solutions, connection references, environment variables, PR checks, pipelines and health thresholds turn low-code apps into governed, testable releases.
hook: Your Power App works until it doesn't, and then it fails in silence. This episode is for makers and platform owners who want to find hidden dependencies, refactor fragile formulas with With(), components and UDFs, and ship through real ALM. You leave with a refactor plan and a governance template that make failure rare.
